passages.note: Mesnard voted Aye on Third Reading of a single-subject bill prohibiting race-based instruction.
Mesnard is listed as Prime sponsor of the bill, which the Governor later vetoed.

passages.provision_quote: A public school, school district or state agency or an employee of a public school, school district or state agency may not provide or allow any person to provide instruction to students or employees that promotes or advocates for any of the following concepts: 1. Judging an individual on the basis of the individual's race or ethnicity.
passages.note: Operative section bars schools from providing instruction promoting listed race-based concepts.

rows.reasoning: As prime sponsor and as an Aye voter on SB 1305 (2023), a single-subject bill, Mesnard enacted operative text barring schools from instruction that 'promotes or advocates for' listed race-based concepts, matching rung 5's 'Prohibit lessons on race, gender, or sexuality that the community considers divisive or age-inappropriate.'
